source: experiments/gpui-player/plan/Q-02-native-baseline.json (commit f9c1a613, tip e40d24d0, Mac16,11 Apple M4 Pro)

idleLibraryDemandedFrames.label: idle library: frames demanded in 5 s
idleLibraryDemandedFrames.basis: Q-02 idle gate: 0 presented samples in 60 s (N5). A count of app-owned frame requests, not a timing, so exact.

pausedPlayerDemandedFrames.label: paused player: frames demanded in 5 s
pausedPlayerDemandedFrames.basis: Same as above, reference song open and paused.

modalOpenDemandedFrames.label: modal open: frames demanded in 5 s
modalOpenDemandedFrames.basis: Same as above, with a modal open.

steadyPlaybackPaintAllocations.label: heap allocations inside lane/playhead paint, 2 s of playback
steadyPlaybackPaintAllocations.basis: Not in Q-02; the C-71 invariant (no per-frame allocation in lane and playhead paint). An exact count from the ui-tests allocator probe.

steadyPlaybackMainThreadRasterizations.label: main-thread waveform rasterizations, 2 s of playback
steadyPlaybackMainThreadRasterizations.basis: Not in Q-02; C-70 invariant. Exact count.

steadyPlaybackWaveformCacheMisses.label: waveform cache misses, 2 s of playback
steadyPlaybackWaveformCacheMisses.basis: Not in Q-02; C-70 invariant. Exact count.

starvedBlocksTotal.label: starvedBlocks, all lanes, hidden scenario
starvedBlocksTotal.basis: Q-02: 0 on every lane in all three runs (N11). An unavailable counter fails the gate.

hiddenScenarioComplete.label: hidden scenario completed (all phases, valid report)
hiddenScenarioComplete.basis: Every Q-02 run completed. A crash, timeout or invalid receipt fails.

songOpenMs.label: song open (300 s, 6 stems)
songOpenMs.basis: Q-02 worst of 3: 193.9 ms. About 15x: a shared macOS runner has cold disks and no tuning; the bound catches a lost cache or a synchronous decode of every stem, which cost seconds.

startupMs.label: cold launch to interactive
startupMs.basis: Q-02 worst of 3: 1728 ms (a cold first run; the other two ~260 ms). About 6x the cold run.

offscreenFramesPerSecond.label: offscreen render+readback throughput
offscreenFramesPerSecond.basis: Q-02 has no offscreen cell (a hidden window presents nothing). Mac receipt (M4 Pro, release+ui-tests, 6 s): 102.9 images/s. The bound is the existing 50 images/s offscreen gate relaxed to 30 for a shared runner (about 3.4x headroom); a 40 ms per-frame stall measured 19.5 images/s.

offscreenPrepareDrawP95Ms.label: offscreen prepare+draw p95
offscreenPrepareDrawP95Ms.basis: Q-02 has no offscreen cell. Mac receipt: p95 1.98 ms. 25 ms is about 12x that, for a runner with a software or shared GPU; the injected 40 ms stall measured p95 51.9 ms.

offscreenStructuralFailures.label: offscreen run checks failed (hidden, glow painted, frames, samples, readback, memory growth)
offscreenStructuralFailures.basis: interface-offscreen-perf.py's own verdict, excluding its throughput line (gated above). A run whose glow never painted, that measured too few frames, or whose RSS grew more than 128 MiB during measurement must not pass on throughput alone.

idleCpuPercent.label: idle CPU (paused, hidden)
idleCpuPercent.why: Runner CPU is shared and its clock differs from the M4 Pro; N6 (< 1%) is owned by C-33/N-packages, judged on the reference Mac.

playingCpuPercent.label: playing CPU (hidden)
playingCpuPercent.why: Same: relative to a different machine under load.

steadyFootprintBytes.label: steady footprint
steadyFootprintBytes.why: Allocator and page behavior differ per macOS image; growth over cycles is a Q-02 beta-gate item.

packageSizeBytes.label: release binary size (CI builds no installer)
packageSizeBytes.why: Q-02 records the DMG; CI has no DMG, so the binary is reported without a comparison. N14 is judged on the packaged DMG.
